name: RVB LLC (ООО «РВБ», Wildberries & Russ)
note: Joint venture created in July 2024 when Wildberries merged with the Russ outdoor-advertising group: 65% held by Wildberries LLC (whose sole owner has been Tatyana Kim since December 2025) and 35% by Stinn LLC, linked to Russ Outdoor (RB.RU, 2025-12-11; Vedomosti, 2024-08-10). RB.RU also names Robert Mirzoyan as RVB's general director.
